entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
FINALLY! I want to return something. Your hold music is a nightmare and this is completely unacceptable service!
I'm very sorry to hear about the wait, I can definitely help you with a return. Could I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Karen Smith, order number 77-Alpha-Bravo-9. I bought this ridiculous helmet and the color is just awful. It looks nothing like the website. I want my money back immediately.

Okay, I have your order pulled up, Ms. Smith. I understand you're unhappy with the color. To make sure I follow the right process, is there a technical fault with the helmet or is the issue a preference?

Are you deaf? I just TOLD YOU it's the color! It's a preference, obviously! The box is unopened, I haven't even breathed on it. Now, are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager and light up your social media with reviews about this disaster?
A manager won't be necessary, I can certainly handle this for you. I just needed to confirm that detail for our system. I see the order was delivered 24 days ago for the AeroPro helmet.
Yes! Get on with it! I don't have all day.
Absolutely. I've just checked our policy for standard gear. Since you are well within the 90-day return window, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. No problem at all.
Oh. ...Really? It's approved just like that?

Yes, ma'am. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied. Getting the right equipment is crucial for your safety on the road, so the look and feel are important. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. Just print it, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off.
Well... okay then. I'll get that sent back today. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
